paragraphs.text: The Ugly Duckling and Me! is a 2006 animated comedy drama film directed by Michael Hegner and Karsten Kiilerich. Intended for a family audience, it is a modern adaptation of the 1843 fairy tale "The Ugly Duckling" by Hans Christian Andersen. The Yorkshire Post described it as a "feel-good" film for family audiences. The film follows a rat named Ratso who strives to become a famous showman. His life changes when an egg falls out of its nest, revealing an ugly duckling with bushy grey wings, and he is forced to become a father. It also won an award at the China International Cartoon and Digital Art Festival. The film initially premiered in Denmark on 6 April 2006.
